title: This free Chrome extension can help you beat location-based surge pricing on hotel bookings
summary: Save some cash on your next trip.
body: TL;DR NordVPN has released a new Chrome extension called PriceMice. It uses AI to check hotel room prices when booked from different countries. Users can then use a VPN to switch to the country with the best price to save money on their booking. Traveling might be fun, but planning a trip and booking everything can be more stressful than anything else. While companies like Google are trying to make trip planning easier with price tracking for flights in AI Mode , what about finding the best hotel deals? That’s the gap NordVPN is trying to fill with its new tool, PriceMice. PriceMice is a browser extension developed by NordVPN that can show you what a room would cost when booked from different countries. Travelers are well acquainted with location-based pricing on hotel booking websites. A room that costs $200 when booked from the US can cost considerably less when booked from another country.
